## Message

```
[X18N2001] No format for resource <detail>
├▶ fix: Map the extension in `formats`, or add a format plugin.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n2001
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

x18n found a locale file, but no format reads its extension.

1. Map the extension to a format id in the config: `formats: { lang: 'json' }`.
2. Or add a plugin that has a format for the extension.

`x18n check` reports this as an `invalid-resource` diagnostic on the file.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
